overview: This Senate resolution designates June 11, 2026, as "National Seersucker Day," every Thursday after that through the end of August 2026 as "Seersucker Thursday," and June 2026 as "Seersucker Appreciation Month." Seersucker is a lightweight, puckered, usually striped fabric popular in hot weather, and the resolution recounts its history in the United States and a long-running custom of senators wearing it on a summer Thursday. It encourages senators to take part, invites local governments and the clothing industry to promote the fabric, and invites Americans to wear their warm-weather best. It is purely ceremonial. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on June 8, 2026.
for: Supporters say the tradition is a lighthearted, bipartisan custom that celebrates an American-made fabric and the cotton farmers behind it.
against: Critics say it is purely symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
